decision_conditions: The proposed mansfard roof extension, by reason of its siting, scale and design, would represent an overly dominant and incongruous form of development that would erode the original appearance of the host property. The scheme would cause less than substantial harm to the CA76 Madrid Road Conservation Area of which it forms part, and there are considered to be no public benefits to outweigh this harm. As such, the proposal would be contrary to the NPPF, the House Extensions and External Alterations SPD and the Local Plan policies 28 & 29, as supported by the [EDIT] Conservation Area Statement and study.
description:
1) Modification of the roof form to include mansard roof to the rear with 2No. pitched dormer windows. New parapet wall built to mirror existing to the rear, enclosed on No. 36 side. Chimney to rear roofslope (adjacent to No.40) removed.

2) Installation of 3no conservation type rooflights to front roofslope and one to rear.
